source_checks.assessment: Warfarin-specific vitamin K consistency and alcohol advice; those vitamin K restrictions do not usually apply to DOACs. Check the actual medicine.

reviewed_text.zh-CN: 直接口服抗凝药不需要套用华法林的维生素K饮食限制；仍按自己药物的说明服用，不把“无需限制维生素K”等同于所有药都没有进食要求。
reviewed_text.en: Direct oral anticoagulants do not require warfarin’s vitamin K dietary restrictions. Follow the instructions for the actual medicine rather than interpreting this as meaning that every drug has no food-related directions.

changed_claim_results.assessment: NHS93/TC printed21 support the specific vitamin-K distinction. Correctly avoids TC broad claim of no dietary interactions and retains actual medicine instructions.

source_checks.locator: Food and drink
source_checks.assessment: Warfarin-specific vitamin K consistency and alcohol advice; those vitamin K restrictions do not usually apply to DOACs. Check the actual medicine.

source_checks.locator: Printed p.21: Do I need to change my diet? (PDF p.22)
source_checks.assessment: Warfarin is affected by vitamin K while DOACs do not require that diet restriction. Source broad wording about all dietary interactions is narrowed; no claim that every drug lacks meal directions.

changed_claim_results.bilingual_assessment: Same conditions, urgency, population and numerical scope in both languages.

reviewed_text.zh-CN: 饮酒和补充剂可能影响抗凝安全；准备改变饮酒量或添加保健品时，把具体产品告诉医生或药师再核对。
reviewed_text.en: Alcohol and supplements may affect anticoagulant safety. Before changing alcohol intake or adding supplements, identify the actual products to a clinician or pharmacist for review.

changed_claim_results.assessment: Existing alcohol/supplement caution is separated and made actionable through discussing actual products. NHS directly supports it; prior AHRQ review is inherited with older oral-anticoagulant scope. No alcohol limit imported.

source_checks.locator: Taking other medicines; Food and drink
source_checks.assessment: Aspirin/NSAIDs including ibuprofen, herbs and other medicines can interact; check with prescribing team/pharmacist before changes. Food advice distinguishes warfarin from DOACs.

source_checks.assessment: Older US oral-anticoagulant patient transcript recommends discussing alcohol/other products with clinicians; not used for DOAC-specific vitamin K or INR claims.

changed_claim_results.bilingual_assessment: Same conditions, urgency, population and numerical scope in both languages.

reviewed_text.zh-CN: 孕产期、癌症、肾功能下降及既往出血会影响风险与药物选择；年龄不是唯一决策因素。
reviewed_text.en: Pregnancy or postpartum status, cancer, reduced kidney function and previous bleeding affect risk and medication choice; age is not the only deciding factor.

changed_claim_results.assessment: Age-not-only-factor is bounded synthesis of pregnancy, cancer, renal function and bleeding considerations. No new stopping threshold.

source_checks.locator: Recommendations 1.3.7–1.3.9; 1.4.1–1.4.8 (official indexed text)
source_checks.assessment: Adult choice/duration considers comorbidity, cancer, renal function, bleeding and recurrence; age alone does not replace combined assessment.

source_checks.locator: Treatment — oral anticoagulation, kidney impairment; Bleeding complications
source_checks.assessment: Renal function influences clearance/regimen; age, cancer and previous bleeding influence bleeding risk. Individual factors, not an age-only stopping rule.

source_checks.locator: Hormonal birth control; Pregnancy and giving birth
source_checks.assessment: Estrogen-containing products differ in risk; pregnancy/postpartum risk and medication discussions.

changed_claim_results.bilingual_assessment: Same conditions, urgency, population and numerical scope in both languages.

reviewed_text.zh-CN: 孕期治疗肺栓塞不能照搬非孕期口服方案：华法林有胎儿风险，直接口服抗凝药通常也不适用。医生常选择肝素类；发现或计划怀孕时尽快联系处方团队安排，不自行停药。
reviewed_text.en: PE treatment in pregnancy cannot simply copy nonpregnant oral regimens: warfarin poses fetal risks and direct oral anticoagulants are generally unsuitable. Clinicians commonly choose heparin. Contact the prescribing team promptly when pregnant or planning pregnancy to arrange care, without independently stopping treatment.

changed_claim_results.assessment: NHS32–43 plus TC support fetal concerns, generally unsuitable oral regimens and clinician-selected heparin. TC patient printed27 directly supports prompt contact on pregnancy discovery/planning; add that locator. No dosing or universal heparin guarantee.

source_checks.locator: Pregnancy
source_checks.assessment: Warfarin fetal risk and usual unsuitability of oral DOACs in pregnancy; heparin can be used; promptly contact team for pregnancy/planning.

source_checks.locator: pp.1–2 — Treatment; oral anticoagulants in pregnancy
source_checks.assessment: Pregnancy-associated VTE is usually treated with LMWH; warfarin placental/fetal risks and limited DOAC pregnancy safety data mean nonpregnant oral regimens are unsuitable. No delivery timing or dose reproduced.

source_checks.locator: Printed pp.6, 23: prescribed use; procedure or surgery (PDF pp.7, 24)
source_checks.assessment: Excess unprescribed medicine increases bleeding and independent interruption can cause new clots; procedure management depends on drug and operation. No universal missed-dose instruction imported.

changed_claim_results.bilingual_assessment: Same conditions, urgency, population and numerical scope in both languages.

reviewed_text.zh-CN: 产后仍需评估血栓和出血风险，并说明是否哺乳。孕期不适用华法林的结论不能直接套到哺乳期：肝素和华法林可以是哺乳期选择，具体药物由团队核对。
reviewed_text.en: After birth, clotting and bleeding risks still need assessment, and the team needs to know whether the person is breastfeeding. Warfarin’s pregnancy restrictions do not transfer directly to breastfeeding: heparin and warfarin can be breastfeeding options, with the actual medicine checked by the team.

changed_claim_results.assessment: NHS44–51 and TC distinguish breastfeeding from pregnancy. TC breastfeeding is printedp3; postpartum bleeding assessment is p4. Correct locator and retrieval scope. No blanket DOAC lactation conclusion.

source_checks.locator: Breastfeeding
source_checks.assessment: Warfarin and heparin are usually compatible with breastfeeding, unlike simply carrying over warfarin pregnancy restrictions.

source_checks.locator: p.3 — Anticoagulation during breastfeeding / postpartum
source_checks.assessment: UFH, LMWH and warfarin breastfeeding options; postpartum thrombosis and bleeding assessment. No blanket promise for all drugs or all postpartum patients.

source_checks.locator: Hormonal birth control; Pregnancy and giving birth
source_checks.assessment: Estrogen-containing products differ in risk; pregnancy/postpartum risk and medication discussions.

changed_claim_results.bilingual_assessment: Same conditions, urgency, population and numerical scope in both languages.

reviewed_text.zh-CN: 儿童血栓常伴其他严重疾病，药物收益和风险随年龄、原有疾病而不同，需要儿科团队评估。这里的成人疗程说明不是儿童用药或疗程表。
reviewed_text.en: Children with clots often have other serious illnesses, and treatment benefits and risks vary with age and underlying disease, requiring pediatric assessment. The adult duration information here is not a pediatric medicine or duration schedule.

changed_claim_results.assessment: ASH/ISTH introduction4–5 directly states serious underlying illness and benefit-risk differences by pediatric population. This is a scope boundary, not a pediatric prescription; one direct authoritative summary suffices.

source_checks.locator: Introduction; 2025 guideline update population
source_checks.assessment: Pediatric VTE often accompanies serious underlying illness and differs from adults in benefit/harm across ages; explanatory boundary, not a pediatric regimen recommendation.

changed_claim_results.bilingual_assessment: Same conditions, urgency, population and numerical scope in both languages.

reviewed_text.zh-CN: 癌症或持续活动受限者可能仍有促血栓因素；老人和肾病患者还需评估出血、药物在体内的清除及耐受，不能只凭年龄决定停药。
reviewed_text.en: Cancer or persistent immobility can maintain clotting risk. Older adults and people with kidney disease also need assessment of bleeding, drug clearance and tolerability rather than stopping treatment on age alone.

changed_claim_results.assessment: NICE/NIH/MSD support persistent clot risks, renal factors and bleeding/tolerance. Drug clearance explains the renal consideration without importing a drug-specific dose cutoff.

source_checks.locator: What raises the risk of VTE? — injury, lack of movement, medical conditions, age, family history
source_checks.assessment: Stasis/injury/hypercoagulability and the listed surgery, immobility, cancer, prior-clot, age and inherited risks.

source_checks.locator: Recommendations 1.3.7–1.3.9; 1.4.1–1.4.8 (official indexed text)
source_checks.assessment: Adult choice/duration considers comorbidity, cancer, renal function, bleeding and recurrence; age alone does not replace combined assessment.

source_checks.locator: Treatment — oral anticoagulation, kidney impairment; Bleeding complications
source_checks.assessment: Renal function influences clearance/regimen; age, cancer and previous bleeding influence bleeding risk. Individual factors, not an age-only stopping rule.

changed_claim_results.bilingual_assessment: Same conditions, urgency, population and numerical scope in both languages.

reviewed_text.zh-CN: 成人抗凝常持续至少3个月，是否延长取决于诱因是否消失、既往复发及出血风险；这是英国NICE和美国患者教育资料中的常见起点，不是满3个月自动停药。
reviewed_text.en: Adult anticoagulation commonly continues for at least three months. Extension depends on persistent provoking factors, prior recurrence and bleeding risk. This is a common starting point in UK NICE guidance and US patient information, not an instruction to stop automatically at three months.

changed_claim_results.assessment: Final NICE1.3.5/1.4.1–8 and NIH120 support adult three-month starting point with continued assessment. UK/US scope and no automatic stopping are explicit.

source_checks.locator: Recommendations 1.3.5; 1.4.1–1.4.8 (official indexed text)
source_checks.assessment: UK adults require at least three months before a decision based on provoked/unprovoked/persistent factors and bleeding/recurrence balance; not automatic stopping.

source_checks.locator: Receive routine follow-up care
source_checks.assessment: US patient education describes three months or longer depending on cause/risk and clinician follow-up; symptom improvement does not itself determine discontinuation.

changed_claim_results.bilingual_assessment: Same conditions, urgency, population and numerical scope in both languages.

reviewed_text.zh-CN: 华法林需要定期查凝血指标，以判断药效是否合适；其他方案可能需查肾肝功能，帮助评估药物处理能力和安全性。按处方团队安排复查，不用症状好转代替检查。
reviewed_text.en: Warfarin requires regular clotting tests to assess its effect; other regimens may need kidney or liver tests to assess drug handling and safety. Follow the prescribing team’s monitoring plan rather than substituting symptom improvement for testing.

changed_claim_results.assessment: NIH123–124 distinguishes warfarin clotting tests from possible kidney/liver monitoring; Mayo324 supports ongoing care. No common interval or universal INR requirement.

source_checks.locator: Receive routine follow-up care — medicine and blood tests
source_checks.assessment: Clotting tests for warfarin; kidney/liver function or other tests for medication safety as appropriate. No common fixed interval imposed.

source_checks.locator: Treatment — Ongoing care
source_checks.assessment: Regular follow-up and blood tests support safe anticoagulation/duration assessment; does not mean all drugs require INR.

changed_claim_results.bilingual_assessment: Same conditions, urgency, population and numerical scope in both languages.

reviewed_text.zh-CN: 持续但稳定的气短或运动耐力下降应提前联系团队，评估是否与残余肺血管问题或其他原因有关；这不等于自行认定再次肺栓塞。
reviewed_text.en: Persistent but stable breathlessness or reduced exercise tolerance warrants earlier contact with the team to assess residual pulmonary vascular problems or other causes; it does not by itself establish recurrent PE.

changed_claim_results.assessment: NIH recovery and AHA2026item10 support assessing persistent functional symptoms and other causes. Stable persistence is separated from a new emergency.

source_checks.locator: Receive routine follow-up care; How can VTE affect health?
source_checks.assessment: Follow-up assesses symptoms, recovery, medication safety and chronic pulmonary vascular sequelae; persistent breathlessness/fatigue merit contact. New fainting is separately triaged by emergency sources.

source_checks.locator: Top Things to Know 10
source_checks.assessment: Adult follow-up asks about PE-related symptoms and functional limitations to identify chronic thromboembolic pulmonary disease or other causes; no waiting period invented.

changed_claim_results.bilingual_assessment: Same conditions, urgency, population and numerical scope in both languages.

reviewed_text.zh-CN: 新发晕厥、明显新胸痛或严重呼吸困难按危险信号立即呼叫急救，不等待下次复诊。
reviewed_text.en: For new fainting, significant new chest pain or severe breathing difficulty, call emergency services immediately as described under warning signs rather than waiting for the next appointment.

changed_claim_results.assessment: Matches care-4. New fainting, significant new chest pain or severe breathing difficulty never waits for routine review. Both languages preserve the same triggers.

source_checks.locator: Symptoms; Urgent advice; Immediate action
source_checks.assessment: Same-day urgent assessment for suspected symptoms; severe breathing difficulty, rapid heartbeat, chest/upper-back pain or passing out need emergency care; do not drive yourself.

source_checks.locator: Warning signs and symptoms
source_checks.assessment: Sudden breathing difficulty, chest pain, fainting and other warning signs warrant immediate emergency help; supports urgency, not all symptoms being required together.

changed_claim_results.bilingual_assessment: Same conditions, urgency, population and numerical scope in both languages.

inherited_claims.assessment: 现有定义无自我确诊或饮食治疗暗示。
DVT 与 PE 部位区分正确；盆腔出处可精确绑定 CDC Overview。
缓慢起病及无腿症状各有明确出处；不是所有 PE 都突然发作。
基础机制说明成立。
风险主干成立；CDC 旧 locator 不覆盖所有列举，补 MSD Etiology 的逐项对应。
未把全部激素产品等同；个体药物讨论属于合理适用说明。
立即评估与来源一致，无要求等待全部症状齐全。
急救行动得到 NHS 和 AHA 相互核对；不自驾直接来自 NHS，属于同一急诊行动的实施方式。病史列表是沟通安排。
NIH 复发段与 CDC 急症处理可组合支持；服药不提供排除保证。
低氧及循环支持为治疗目标无错；原所引两节只直接支持抗凝主干，新增专业 General treatment 可定位。
经选择才院外治疗正确；补 AHA/MSD 的低风险条款，未给读者自行评风险算法。
溶栓适用范围和大出血风险交叉支持；未要求所有影像血块溶栓。
饮食不能替代所需抗凝，是已读治疗和饮食资料的边界归纳；不宣称完成所有食物疗效的系统综述。
护理导读为后续安排概括，不强制每个常识词双源。
活动/观察有直接支持；记录变化是低风险落实方式，无新运动阈值。
头撞击即时联系和携卡已由 NHS 与 AHRQ 索引交叉；严重出血另有 NIH/NHS。两 NHS 页面本身不算双源。
没有保证每位病人完全恢复或固定恢复时间。
当前两 NIH 页同源；此为机制解释，无数字风险或独立治疗行动，足以支持，AHA 病人页亦吻合。
休克/死亡与及时处理方向成立；Mayo 不直接解释休克，补 AHA/MSD 适用段。
CTEPH 并发症与复诊方向成立；改精确 locator，并与 2026 成人功能症状随访建议核对。未夸成多数患者。
预防不保证零风险的边界合理，不需要为普通限定另凑材料。
CDC 可支持抗凝/压迫预防；原 NIH 滤器位置不能代替压迫措施，MSD 病因/预防概述可补。不要借药是处方用途边界。
不设所有人统一袜/药方案；未硬搬 NHS/CDC 不同活动间隔。
